notes.subject: brukim kontrak
notes.rationale: בגד is to act covertly/deal treacherously; 'brukim kontrak' keeps the covenant-betrayal picture.

notes.subject: חדש
notes.rationale: 'mun' = new moon or month: 'a month (time) will devour them' vs 'the New Moon (feast) will devour them' (JPS/ASV).

notes.subject: wantaim
notes.rationale: Preposition ⟨wantaim⟩ supplied — Hebrew juxtaposes 'devour them' with 'their portions' directly.

translation: Long Yahwe ol i brukim kontrak, long wanem ol i karim ol pikinini bilong ol man bilong arapela ples; nau mun bai kaikai ol ⟨wantaim⟩ ⟨את⟩ ol hap bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man bilong arapela ples
